description.zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The ID of the KMS resource. Only key IDs are supported.
The ID of the region to which the KMS resource belongs.

description.zh: KMS资源类型，当前仅支持**key**（密钥）。
description.en: The type of the KMS resource. Only key is supported.

description.zh: KMS资源所属的阿里云账号ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the KMS resource belongs.
The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.
